title: Multiplexer Module - Band 8 (900 MHz) for WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Mei-Ling Chen

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Multiplexer Module filter targeting Band 8 (900 MHz) for WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter. The filter is designed on 42° YX LiTaO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 3504.5 MHz and bandwidth of 230.7 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Multiplexer Module
- Frequency Band: Band 8 (900 MHz)
- Application: WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter
- Substrate: 42° YX LiTaO3
- Package: WLP (Wafer Level Package)
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Andover HQ Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Multiplexer Module design targeting Band 8 (900 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       3504.5 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       230.7 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 3.8 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 11.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 46.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 39.0 dB
Q Factor:               14340
Temperature Coefficient:-29.9 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.8 x 2.1 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   8
Electrode Material:     W
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the Multiplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 42° YX LiTaO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 3504.5 MHz, BW 230.7 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 3.8 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (WLP (Wafer Level Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, 42° YX LiTaO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Anritsu MS46122B ShockLine.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 10514 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 3.8 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 11.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 346 MHz offset >= 46.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 7 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 13.1 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +33 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 85%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-09-26
Devices Tested:         30
Insertion Loss (meas):  3.47 dB
Return Loss (meas):     12.8 dB
Rejection (meas):       48.5 dB
Isolation (meas):       43.7 dB
Q Factor (meas):        14340
Group Delay Variation:  4.9 ns
Power Handling:         +32 dBm
Die Yield:              92.1%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Multiplexer Module design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 8 (900 MHz).
b) Insertion loss is marginally above target; electrode thickness optimization recommended.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) ESD robustness exceeded specification by 2x margin.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
